rows.originalName: WebDAV resource-id protocol fixture supports pairwise proof without content or numeric inode IDs
rows.replacementName: WebDAV resource-id protocol fixture supports pairwise proof without content or numeric inode IDs
rows.reason: The current MockDav already emits one DAV:resource-id. The old fixture appends another, so its unchanged exact-one resolver properly returns unknown. Replace the known helper property before injecting the fixture map; retain successful distinct copies, alias rejection, missing-property refusal and a new deliberate duplicate-property refusal.
rows.review: accepted explicit input reconciliation, not unchanged-input acceptance

audit.inputChange: Replace the helper-owned DAV:resource-id rather than appending a second property.
audit.retainedChecks: Exactly one controlled identifier; same-entry EINVAL; missing/duplicate ENOTSUP; only PROPFIND on refused copies; source/target bytes.
audit.limit: Test-only proposal proofCopy/resolver, not a new public cp/mv or provider workflow.
